factors.warning: Belgian producer proxy; characterization vintage differs from IPCC AR6 utility factors.

warnings: Only climate is characterized. Nutrient emissions require separate characterization factors.
Whole-plant attributional burdens and optional quality-verified substitution credits are reported separately.
Biogenic CO2 is reported as a memorandum, without claiming permanent carbon storage or a complete carbon cycle.

maturity_summary.interpretation: Counts describe evidence and completeness only; they are not a validation score or TRL estimate.

operating_profit.definition: Original modeled annual sales minus partial OPEX, before support, tax and capital recovery; no assumed performance improvements.

climate.definition: Attributional plant climate estimate; partial inventory may be used for screening and must be completed before investment decisions

net_carbon.definition: Operational climate load converted from t CO2e to t C, less assumed carbon stored in furniture and soil-retained nutrient-rich solids; screening proxy.

npv.definition: After-tax constant-account screening cash flows; explicit CAPEX override where provided, upfront grant, user-rated labor/utilities/logistics, product sales, and time-limited operating support; working capital recovered at end of project.

subsidy_granted.definition: Present value of the assumed upfront CAPEX grant plus discounted operating-support overlay; the Pareto analysis computes the overlay dynamically from candidate biomethane volume, not as a fixed €/t-feed rate. This is not an eligibility or award estimate.

route_trl.definition: No evidence-backed route-level TRL aggregation exists; never inferred from component maturity

carbon_assessment.method: Operational climate load converted to t C (12/44) minus assumed furniture carbon stock and soil-retained nutrient-rich-solids carbon.
limitations: Furniture conversion losses and end-of-life are excluded.
10% soil retention is a screening assumption, not measured for this product.

Operational climate inventory covers only included gate-to-gate groups and declared emission factors.
